written_before_any_scored_run_basis: No SCORED run exists at this commit: docs/evidence/5087-hypothesis/ carries no log at all. The only log in the tree's evidence bundles that predates this record is docs/evidence/7949-capstone/e1-e2.log, which is UNPREREGISTERED by its own lines (prereg=UNPREREGISTERED, every verdict=UNPREREGISTERED, result=UNPREREGISTERED, exit=3) and scores a DIFFERENT criterion set on this same corpus. No arm of this experiment had been run when these bars were frozen; the author had seen no created-node count for either arm.

criteria.metric: creatednewnodes (extraction-claim Points + minted Object/Event nodes) in the S3-ON arm ÷ the same count in the S3-OFF arm, summed over the 7 sessions — the primary bar
criteria.denominator: the S3-OFF arm's creatednewnodes total over the 7 sessions (floor ≥ 30 nodes)

criteria.metric: planted units recovered by content (macrosurvivalcounts().survived) against the ARM's whole Point set — the guard: real-fact count may not fall
criteria.denominator: the S3-OFF arm's recovered count, over the 90 planted units

criteria.metric: sessions whose creatednewnodes fell relative to the matched OFF session (corroboration; a qualifier, never the primary bar; session 1 is blind in both arms and is expected ≈ 0)

session-arms whose receipt proves the arm's S3 state — ON: real searchgraph executed (counter ≥ 1) with mode="real", degraded=False, queriesrun>=1; OFF: queriesrun==0, degraded=False, an OFF-ARM reason, and zero real-function calls — arm integrity, asserted first
graph-wide operator-type edge count (operatorrelationships) in the ON arm — the guard: operator volume may not fall (an edge count, NOT recovery of the planted edges)
criteria.denominator: the S3-OFF arm's operator-edge count; the 15 planted operator edges are the corpus's reference scale

criteria.metric: model calls spent by the ON arm (cost disclosure)

falsifier: ratio ≈ 1.0 (or any ratio > 0.75) falsifies the hypothesis, closes #10463 and changes the epic's plan
rerun_policy: one run of the pair is the measurement; a repeat requires a NEW pre-registration
below_floor: REFUSED, which is neither a pass nor a fail
verdict_mapping: E1 met and E2a and E4 met -> HYPOTHESIS-SUPPORTED
E1 met but a guard violated -> HYPOTHESIS-FALSIFIED (ratio X, GUARD-VIOLATED: <metric>)
